additions.agent/tests/api/test_mona_backtest_input:
"""Hosted native backtest-input listing over existing run directories."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from src.api.mona_reads import register_mona_reads
from src.config.accessor import reset_env_config

_AUTH = {"Authorization": "Bearer stock-vibe-test-token"}


def _write_input(run_dir: Path, *, state: str | None = None, equity: bool = False) -> None:
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (run_dir / "config.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({
            "codes": ["600519.SH"],
            "start_date": "2026-09-16",
            "end_date": "2026-10-15",
            "source": "tencent",
            "engine": "daily",
        }),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    code_dir = run_dir / "code"
    code_dir.mkdir()
    (code_dir / "signal_engine.py").write_text(
        "class SignalEngine: pass\\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (run_dir / "req.json").write_text(
        '{"prompt":"must not be returned"}\\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    if state is not None:
        (run_dir / "state.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status": state}), encoding="utf-8")
    if equity:
        artifacts = run_dir / "artifacts"
        artifacts.mkdir()
        (artifacts / "equity.csv").write_text(
            "timestamp,equity,drawdown\\n2026-10-15,101000,0\\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )


@pytest.fixture
def native_client(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
    home = tmp_path / "private"
    home.mkdir()
    (home / "runs").mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOSTED", "1")
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOME", str(home))
    monkeypatch.setenv("API_AUTH_KEY", "stock-vibe-test-token")
    reset_env_config()
    app = FastAPI()
    register_mona_reads(app)
    try:
        yield TestClient(app, client=("127.0.0.1", 50000)), home
    finally:
        reset_env_config()


def _snapshot(paths: list[Path]) -> dict[str, tuple[int, bytes | None]]:
    state = {}
    for path in paths:
        info = path.stat()
        state[str(path)] = (
            info.st_mtime_ns,
            path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None,
        )
    return state


def test_backtest_inputs_excludes_research_only_and_linked_code_without_writes(
    native_client, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    client, home = native_client
    runs = home / "runs"
    draft = runs / "run_draft"
    completed = runs / "run_completed"
    research = runs / "research_only"
    linked = runs / "run_linked_code"
    _write_input(draft)
    _write_input(completed, state="success", equity=True)
    research.mkdir()
    (research / "state.json").write_text('{"status":"success"}', encoding="utf-8")
    _write_input(linked)

    external_code = tmp_path / "outside-code"
    external_code.mkdir()
    (external_code / "signal_engine.py").write_text(
        "class SignalEngine: pass\\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    link = linked / "code"
    (link / "signal_engine.py").unlink()
    link.rmdir()
    if os.name == "nt":
        command = f'mklink /J "{link}" "{external_code}"'
        result = subprocess.run(command, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            pytest.skip("Windows did not permit creation of a temporary directory junction")
        junction_tag = getattr(link.lstat(), "st_reparse_tag", None)
        assert junction_tag == getattr(stat, "IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT", None)
    else:
        try:
            os.symlink(external_code, link, target_is_directory=True)
        except OSError:
            pytest.skip("Temporary directory symlinks are unavailable")

    tracked = [
        runs, draft, draft / "config.json", draft / "code", draft / "code" / "signal_engine.py",
        completed, completed / "config.json", completed / "state.json",
        completed / "artifacts", completed / "artifacts" / "equity.csv",
        research, research / "state.json", linked, linked / "config.json", link,
        external_code, external_code / "signal_engine.py",
    ]
    before = _snapshot(tracked)
    response = client.get("/mona/backtest-inputs?limit=100", headers=_AUTH)
    after = _snapshot(tracked)

    assert response.status_code == 200
    items = response.json()
    assert [item["run_id"] for item in items] == ["run_completed", "run_draft"]
    assert items[0]["status"] == "success"
    assert items[1]["status"] == "not_run"
    assert items[0]["codes"] == ["600519.SH"]
    assert items[0]["start_date"] == "2026-09-16"
    assert items[0]["end_date"] == "2026-10-15"
    assert items[0]["source"] == "tencent"
    assert items[0]["engine"] == "daily"
    assert all("prompt" not in item and str(home) not in json.dumps(item) for item in items)
    assert before == after


def test_backtest_inputs_requires_native_auth_and_bounds_limit(native_client) -> None:
    client, _home = native_client

    assert client.get("/mona/backtest-inputs").status_code == 401
    assert client.get("/mona/backtest-inputs?limit=101", headers=_AUTH).status_code == 422
    response = client.get("/mona/backtest-inputs", headers=_AUTH)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == []


def test_backtest_inputs_route_is_not_registered_in_standalone_mode(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.delenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOSTED", raising=False)
    app = FastAPI()
    register_mona_reads(app)
    assert all(route.path != "/mona/backtest-inputs" for route in app.routes)
